scripts.desktop:build: npm run desktop:build:main && npm run desktop:build:renderer && npm run desktop:build:assets
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run desktop:build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.desktop:release: npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.desktop:publish: npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml --publish always
scripts.desktop:publish:selfsigned: npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml --publish always -c.mac.identity=- -c.mac.sign=desktop/build/sign.cjs -c.mac.notarize=false -c.mac.hardenedRuntime=false
scripts.desktop:publish:adhoc: npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml --publish always -c.mac.identity=- -c.mac.hardenedRuntime=false -c.mac.notarize=false
scripts.desktop:publish:beta: npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml --publish always -c.publish.releaseType=prerelease
scripts.desktop:publish:beta:selfsigned: npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml --publish always -c.publish.releaseType=prerelease -c.mac.identity=- -c.mac.sign=desktop/build/sign.cjs -c.mac.notarize=false -c.mac.hardenedRuntime=false
scripts.desktop:publish:beta:adhoc: npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml --publish always -c.publish.releaseType=prerelease -c.mac.identity=- -c.mac.hardenedRuntime=false -c.mac.notarize=false
